model: index-reweight flow (BCOM primary, GSCI stacked): the drift tracker, the flow formula, Gate C0, Stages R1-R3; frozen for the January 2027 forward event (IR-A10)

records.R0: D634 (pre-reg 8fb1619, runner a4ebd9b + 68397c2, result fc98f59, re-run 57824da: RESOLVED)
records.C0: D635 (pre-reg e001171, POWER b0e992a, runner bef2903; not yet run)
records.R1_R3: D636 (pre-reg 1315ecf with s.11, POWER 7ec7a21, runners c019f34; not yet run)

calendar: BCOM business day: > 50% of CIPs open (prior-year CIPs to det); det = BD4 of January (IR-A3)
drift: w_i(t) = CIM_i x H_i(t) / sum_j CIM_j x H_j(t); CIM_i proportional to CIP_i / P_lead,Jan(det) (IR-A4)
flow_bcom: dN_i = AUM_B x (CIP_i(y) - w_i(det)) / (P_i x mult_i)
flow_gsci: dN_G,i per $1bn = 1e9 x (w_new,i - w_old,i) / (P_i x mult_i), GSCI dollar weights CPW x price-in-dollars at BD4 of January (D636 s.1, s.11)

aum_bn.2027: the figure published with the 2027 targets

kappa: Gate C0's full in-sample estimate from its one run (D635 s.5); if C0 has not run at the freeze, whatever the frozen run_gate_c0.py returns on the in-sample (IR-A10)

c0_gate.price_clause: L/N spread move on 0.7 sqrt impact, slope t >= 2

r1.fill: close of bar t0+1 (last trade before t0+2 min)

B.entry: common, 10 min before the earliest chosen window

r1.tests: mean gross >= mean cost AND Webb wild cluster bootstrap by year, Holm across A and B, p < 0.05
r1.adoption: H-R1 AND yearly sign test (>= 9 of 10) AND calibration 90% CI overlapping [0.5, 2], with C0 PASSED

r2.entry: settlement of BD9, against the total flow

cost_usd: 16 + one tick per round trip, full size

placebos.kill: overturns a pooled pass only (D636 s.11)

forward_2027.consistency: the 2027 cross-sectional correlation and calibration ratio within the 2016-2025 90% intervals, same sign (s.11 v1.3)
forward_2027.track3: a fill and cost check only, never efficacy evidence (R-D21)

settlement_windows: data/settlement_windows.csv: measured rows 2015-12 -> 2025-02 (KE from 2017, ZM from 2016); current_only rows from 2026-09-21
not_read_before_freeze: any 2027 BCOM target-weight or GSCI CPW publication, pro-forma or advisory document (IR-A10)
vault_rule: A10: 2025-03-01 -> 2026-09-18 opened only in the programme's joint vault run
